controls.title: Project license and distribution terms are explicit
controls.description: Detect license files and distribution constraints.
checks: Detect license files and distribution constraints.
manual_questions: What concrete evidence supports: Project license and distribution terms are explicit?
controls.pass_condition: A LICENSE/COPYING/NOTICE file or explicit package license metadata is present.
controls.partial_condition: Distribution terms are referenced but not represented by a recognized license artifact/metadata field.
controls.fail_condition: No explicit license/distribution metadata is present in the inspected source tree.
controls.not_applicable_condition: Applicability engine records NOT_APPLICABLE with an explicit reason.
